decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The demolition must be completed within 5 years of the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed demolition shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the documents submitted (Structural inspection ref. 3691 Issue 02 dated 22 May 2018 prepared by Momentum Structural Engineers, Demolition Traffic Management Plan June 2018 Revision A prepared by SGB Demolition, Notes on Demolition of Fire Damaged Restaurant - Asbestos Hazard dated July 2018 prepared by Facility Audits, Outline Method Statement incorporating Risk Assessment  prepared by SGB Demolition received on 21/08/2018, email from Michael Rushe at ICE Architects dated 14/09/2018 received on 14/09/2018 and plan ref. ITL12493-SK-002 received on 18/09/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Notification of demolition of the two storey restaurant building to the rear of the Vista Business Centre.
